ff_feature_modes.description: Default: all features free (on) for every device. Per-device paid gating uses ff_force_paid_installation_ids (app-side), not Firebase Conditions.

ff_unlock_installation_ids.description: CSV Firebase Installation IDs → full unlock (all on + Pro limits). Staff / promo.

ff_force_paid_installation_ids.description: CSV Firebase Installation IDs → force all features to paid (test paywall). Replace XXX with real Installation ID from About (7 taps on version).
